item.tethered.red_thread.desc: Right-click another player to tie yourselves together.
item.tethered.upgrade.desc: Use to upgrade your shared rope to %s blocks.
item.tethered.ender_thread.desc: Unlocks Ender Call: teleport to your partner.
item.tethered.golden_thread.desc: Unlocks Unhook: loosen the rope whenever you like.
msg.tethered.paired: A red thread winds itself around you and %s. You are tethered.
msg.tethered.paired_hint: Crouch to brace. Hold R to haul. Crouch + G to throw your partner. Press J for the journal and map.
msg.tethered.waiting: You feel a loose thread around your wrist... waiting for someone to tie it to.
msg.tethered.already_tied: One of you is already tethered.
msg.tethered.not_tied: You are not tethered to anyone.
msg.tethered.already_strong: Your rope is already this strong.
msg.tethered.you_down: You're down! Your partner can crouch next to you to help you up.
msg.tethered.partner_down: %s is down! Crouch next to them to help them up.
msg.tethered.launch_brace: Crouch on solid ground to brace first.
msg.tethered.launch_far: Your partner needs to be right next to you.
msg.tethered.ender_needed: You need the Ender Thread to do that.
msg.tethered.unhook_needed: Only the Golden Thread can be loosened.
msg.tethered.unhooked: The Golden Thread loosens. You can wander freely.
msg.tethered.tree.status: Heart Tree: %s. To grow into %s it wants:
msg.tethered.tree.together_hint: It only grows when you are both beside it. Heart Shards come from finishing each island's quests.
msg.tethered.tree.waits: The Heart Tree waits for both of you...
msg.tethered.tree.grew: The Heart Tree grows, and new islands rise.
msg.tethered.tree.full_bloom: The Heart Tree is in full bloom.
msg.tethered.tree.none: There is no Heart Tree in this world yet.
weaver.tethered.ending.1: The Weaver: "The tree has bloomed. You no longer need my thread to survive."
weaver.tethered.ending.2: "So I ask you both: shall I cut it, and set you free?"
weaver.tethered.ending.keep_hover: Your rope becomes the Golden Thread.
weaver.tethered.ending.cut_hover: The rope disappears. You each keep a Red Thread.
weaver.tethered.ending.waiting: You made your choice. Waiting for your partner...
weaver.tethered.ending.partner_chose: %s has made their choice. What is yours?
weaver.tethered.ending.disagree: The Weaver smiles: "You don't agree yet. Talk it over, then choose again."
weaver.tethered.ending.kept: "Then it was never my thread holding you together."
weaver.tethered.ending.cut_done: "Go where you like. I suspect you'll go together anyway."
weaver.tethered.ending.not_yet: The Weaver has not asked you anything yet.
hud.tethered.partner_down: %s is down! Crouch next to them
hud.tethered.you_down_hint: Hold on, %s can help you up
advancements.tethered.root.title: Tethered
advancements.tethered.paired.title: Tied Together
advancements.tethered.hanging_by_a_threa: Dangle below your partner for two seconds.
advancements.tethered.slingshot.title: Slingshot
advancements.tethered.slingshot.descript: Throw your partner with the Launch key.
advancements.tethered.saved_you.title: I've Got You
advancements.tethered.saved_you.descript: Help your partner back up after they go down.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_1: Grow the Heart Tree for the first time.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_2: Bring home the first Heart Shard.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_3: Grow the Heart Tree to its third stage.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_4: Grow the Heart Tree to its fourth stage.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_5: Grow the Heart Tree to its fifth stage.
advancements.tethered.cut_free.title: Free Together
advancements.tethered.attuned.title: Attuned
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_6: Grow the Heart Tree to its sixth stage.
advancements.tethered.heart_tree.stage_7: Bring the Heart Tree to full bloom.
item.tethered.weavers_journal.desc: The map of the islands, your quests and the Heart Tree. Press J to open.
msg.tethered.journal_hint: You found the Weaver's Journal. Press J (or use it) to see the map and your quests.
msg.tethered.tree_too_young: The Heart Tree isn't strong enough for this rope yet (needs stage %s).
msg.tethered.island.unlocked: The Heart Tree's roots reach out across the sky toward %s.
msg.tethered.anchor.attuned: You attune the Anchor Stone of %s together. The Heart Tree can carry you here now.
msg.tethered.anchor.attuned_already: The Anchor Stone of %s hums softly.
msg.tethered.anchor.together: You need to attune it together. Bring your partner here.
msg.tethered.travel.locked: The Heart Tree needs to reach Young Tree before it can carry you.
msg.tethered.travel.where: Stand at the Heart Tree or an attuned Anchor Stone to travel.
msg.tethered.travel.not_attuned: You haven't attuned that island's Anchor Stone yet.
msg.tethered.travel.together: Your partner needs to be right next to you.
msg.tethered.quest.shard: A Heart Shard appears in %s's hands. Bring it to the Heart Tree.
msg.tethered.quest.nothing_to_hand_in: You don't have any of the items this quest needs.
screen.tethered.map.blank: The map is blank. Play in a Tethered Sky world to see the islands.
screen.tethered.map.locked: Unknown. Grow the Heart Tree to reach it.
screen.tethered.map.visited: Visited. Attune its Anchor Stone together.
screen.tethered.map.click_travel: Click to travel here (stand at the tree or an anchor, together)
screen.tethered.map.legend: White: you   Pink: your partner   Brown lines: Rootways
screen.tethered.map.legend_travel: White: you   Pink: your partner   Click an attuned island or the tree to travel
screen.tethered.quests.locked: This island is still out of reach. Grow the Heart Tree and its roots will lead you there.
screen.tethered.tree.next: Next: %s. Right-click the Heart Tree to see what it needs (usually a Heart Shard from the newest island).
task.tethered.tree_stage: Grow the Heart Tree to stage %s
blessing.tethered.1.desc: Crops and saplings near the Heart Tree grow faster.
blessing.tethered.2.desc: You regenerate health while you stay within 12 blocks of each other.
blessing.tethered.3.desc: Travel between the Heart Tree and attuned Anchor Stones (from the journal map).
blessing.tethered.5.desc: When one of you eats, the other is fed a little too.
blessing.tethered.6.desc: No monsters spawn within 48 blocks of the Heart Tree.
blessing.tethered.7.desc: The last root reaches Bloomreach, where the Weaver waits.
